reason: As someone who hears these complaints every year, I immediately wonder about their margins on brand-name drugs when they complain about generic rates; Document A preempts my skepticism by honestly acknowledging that some of them make up part of the loss on brands. Document B not only omits this, it overstates its case by claiming they are doing a full fifth of their work at a loss when the $1.80 loss only applies to their top 20 generics.
